plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Massage Therapy Entrepreneurship, Business, AAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/business-massage-therapy-entrepreneurship-aas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid, hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnote 3 on this page as 'See program recommendations or requirements' — those slots are modeled as choice slots with that definition; see advisor. The schedule grid also includes unnamed slots with no footnotes (1st semester: one 1-unit; 4th semester: one 2-unit); they are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. Massage courses follow Nevada local ordinances; graduates are eligible for the national certification exam and licensure. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
